programs.title: Megatransporty
programs.desc: The MTD team has a narrow, gravel road ahead of them.Visibility is limited.Pilots walk alongside the set to minimize danger and remotely control the trailer if necessary.In the Dutch port of Harlingen, the Transdor Chlechowicz team is ready to depart with a 35-ton boat.However, there is a problem with securing the load.JCS is to transport a structural element of the coal feeder of the heat and power plant in Kozienice.The team must first build a structure to support and stabilize the load.The situation is also complicated by the absence of one of the pilots.
